title: Quietly Spicy Portuguese Kiwifruit Toast
description: A spicy and light Portuguese dish featuring kiwifruit and toast, perfect for a sick day, and keto-friendly.
instructions: Preheat a non-stick skillet over medium heat.
Butter the almond flour bread slices on both sides.
Place the bread slices in the skillet and cook until lightly toasted.
Flip the bread slices over and cook for an additional 2 minutes.
In a small bowl, whisk the eggs and set aside.
Add the chopped Portuguese chili peppers to the skillet and cook for 1 minute.
Pour the whisked eggs over the chili peppers in the skillet.
Scramble the eggs until they are cooked through.
Assemble the toast by placing the scrambled eggs on top of the toasted bread, then topping with sliced kiwifruit.
Season with salt and black pepper to taste.
